thread:
rachael: Heads-up: planning a regional routing policy change for APAC -> EU tilt tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Target is to nudge 15% traffic off the APAC edge into EU for 2h, smoke, then step up if healthy. Who's owning the deploy and DNS TTL tweak?
jamal: I can own the deploy and monitor. I'll be on-call during the window. planning to do a canary to 5% first at 09:00 then 15% at 09:20.
samir: Add me for observability checks — I'll validate p50/p95 latency and error rates, plus cache hit ratios.
megan: I'll run the smoke checklist and perform app-level sanity. Please post the smoke curl commands here.
rachael: Thanks. Smoke commands: `curl -I https://api.redwood.example/health -H \"Host: api.eu.redwood.example\"` and `curl -sS https://embed.redwood.example/metrics/quick?region=eu | jq .status` — expect 200 + \"ok\". Also confirm KV cache warmup >80%.
jamal: Noted. Rollout plan in short: 09:00 5% -> 09:10 smoke -> 09:20 15% -> 10:20 evaluate -> 11:00 either continue or roll back. Rollback is revert routing policy and restore TTL to 300s if we change it.
aaron: Who has permission to change the Route53 policy and lower TTLs? I can if needed but will be heads-down until 08:30 UTC.
lina: I can swap TTL to 60s right before the shift and revert after. I'll coordinate with Jamal.
megan: Acceptance criteria for step increase: p95 latency change < 20ms, error budget <1%, no client-visible 5xx spikes for 10m post-step. If any of those breach, we rollback to previous weights.
samir: Also watch for cache miss rate delta > 5% — that tends to surface model cold-start effects.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `routing-change-v2` by jamal scheduled for 2109876600. CI: green.
jamal: I queued it to start at 09:00 UTC. I'll post the canary run output here.
rachael: Quick final checks: anyone planning maintenance in APAC tonight? If yes, we should postpone.
megan: No APAC maintenance from my side.
jamal: Canary log excerpt (09:00:12): `canary apply: weights apac=95 eu=5 -> OK`, checks: health 200/200, p95 delta +8ms. :thumbsup:
samir: Saw the metrics stream — minor latency bump but within target. Continuing to 15%.
jamal: 09:20:15: `weights apac=85 eu=15 -> OK`. Running 15m steady-state checks.
megan: Smoke results at 09:36: app checks OK, feature flags intact, synthetic tests pass.
aaron: DNS TTL lowered to 60s at 08:55 UTC by lina. Revert scheduled at 12:00 UTC.
lina: Reverting TTL to 300s at 12:00 unless we call it earlier.
rachael: Thanks team. If anything goes sideways, use this thread + call me @rachael. Post a final summary once we've either promoted or rolled back.
jamal: Will do. If rollback needed, I'll issue `routing-change-v2 rollback` and ping ops.
megan: Postmortem owner assigned in advance? If we stay green, quick write-up in #eng-retros. If rollback, full P0 doc.\samar: (typo) sorry, ignore
samir: all good.
jamal: Final note: observed an edge cache warmup pattern — we may want a follow-up to pre-warm a subset of keys next week to reduce p95 blips.
rachael: Added a follow-up action for research. End of thread.
